title: Benchmarking Synthetic Data Generation Models
summary: A benchmarking harness that trains and evaluates multiple synthetic-data-generation libraries (SDV, Gretel Synthetics, Synthcity) across many tabular and sequential datasets, with hyperparameter optimization and imputation options. SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE and PAR synthesizers are imported and run as one of the three benchmarked library families, and its evaluation module (evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic) is called to score synthetic output quality.
